definitions: A device which maintains a fixed distance between two objects, especially between a surface and a sign or electrical wiring.
For use at a distance sufficient from the target to allow defensive fire to be evaded.

blocks.text: A Mexican standoff  is a confrontation where no strategy exists that allows any party to achieve victory. Anyone initiating aggression might trigger their own demise. At the same time, the parties are unable to extract themselves from the situation without either negotiating a truce or suffering a loss, maintaining strategic tension until one of those three potential organic outcomes occurs or some outside force intervenes.
